en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4842 - Ziyad ibn al-Mundhir narrated from Abu al-Ward that
Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) was asked, while I was present, about a man who said to his wife, "You are to me like the back of my mother" a hundred times.

Abu Jafar Imam Al-Baqir (as) said: "Is he able to free a slave for each time?"
The man replied: "No."
Imam (as) said: "Is he able to feed sixty needy people for each time?"
Imam (as) said: "Is he able to fast for two consecutive months for each time?"
Imam (as) then said: "They should be separated."
